items.text: the mixer pads now fill the whole pane and arrange themselves to fit (four across and two down upright, a single row of eight on a wide screen), so the mixer no longer needs scrolling on a phone
on a phone or tablet, opening the heads-up display could zoom the whole page out (since 0.3.0). The Form list had a hidden element parked far off to the right; it is now kept inside the list

the hold hand. Hold the pencil button and choose Hold hand (a closed fist): a touched note keeps sounding until you touch it again, switch off its row or column, or choose "Let go of all". It keeps playing while you use the mixer
rail buttons with more to them carry a small notch. Hold one (or right-click, or press the menu key) and its choices fly out to the left
hold the look button (how the notes draw) for rain, bloom or off, and the size of the marks; hold the pencil for Play by hand or Edit the pad

the Form is now as many movements as you like, laid out like the index: drag the grip to re-order, the crossed eye mutes (skips) a movement, S solos it and loops it so you can practise, fold or pin as you wish
each movement has its own length, what the players do, composer's notes, and can hold a look (grid, lines, sounds, mix, tempo) that comes in when it begins
copy or cut a movement, or the whole form, as text; paste it back or into another Battanboo; save a form as a template in "My forms", with Undo for changes
while an overlay covers the grid, the edit tools and the halo, colour and shape bar dim, since you cannot see what they would change

the right-hand rail has a new order. The pencil is on top with its editing tools beneath it, then the clock and the colour/view button, and the heads-up display (mixer, sliders, gestures) is now the bottom button on the right. It stays put whether you play or edit.
held sideways (an iPad or a computer), the whole bar is on one line again; the two-row bar with tempo first is for upright screens
the tempo bar and undo/redo are the first row under the grid; the robot, dice, scenes and recording come second, on upright screens
